ui.audio_import.title: Audio singing practice
ui.audio_import.help: Play the original immediately. Analyze the whole song or a selection up to120 seconds. Pitch and lyrics are reviewable suggestions; confirmation is required.
ui.audio_import.lyrics_placeholder: Optional corrected lyrics or timestamped LRC. Supplied lyrics take priority over ASR.
ui.audio_import.finish_pending: Finish or discard the pending audio result before importing another song.
ui.audio_import.ready: Audio candidate ready; preview before applying.
ui.audio_import.replace_message: Replace the current score “%1” with this audio-analysis candidate? Review uncertain notes afterwards.
ui.audio_import.applied: Audio candidate applied; save to keep it.
ui.audio_import.original_mode_help: Original mode includes recorded vocals and instruments. Melody mute applies only to synthesized score playback.
ui.audio_import.no_original: Import or reopen an available original audio file first.
ui.audio_import.mapping_stale: Original recording: score mapping is missing or outdated.
ui.audio_import.outside_selection: Original recording: outside the analyzed selection.
ui.audio_import.lyrics_help: Import timestamped LRC for source-time alignment, or plain lyrics for provisional character-to-note placement. Empty notes remain lyric-free; correct individual notes in the inspector.
ui.audio_import.lyrics_overflow: Some lyric characters had no available note; review the source text and alignment.
ui.audio_import.lyrics_provisional: Plain-text lyric placement is provisional, not a measured singing alignment.
ui.audio_import.exit_running: Cancel audio analysis and exit? Choose No to keep waiting.
messages.audio_import.interval: Select a positive interval no longer than 120 seconds.
messages.audio_import.lyrics_file: The lyric file could not be read or exceeds 1 MiB.
messages.audio_import.notation_invalid_s: The melody is invalid and cannot be laid out.
messages.audio_import.notation_too_large: The score is too large for this notation view; analyze a shorter selection.
messages.audio_import.notation_layout_fa: The numbered score image could not be produced or saved.
messages.audio_source.invalid_position: Original-audio position is outside the file duration.
messages.audio_source.not_open: No original audio device is open.
messages.audio_transcription.duration_li: Original audio must be no longer than 20 minutes.
messages.audio_transcription.invalid_sel: Invalid audio selection, tempo or key settings.
messages.audio_transcription.invalid_whi: Local lyric recognition returned invalid timestamped JSON.
messages.audio_transcription.lyrics_alig: Lyric timestamps are provisional; singing and melisma require correction.
messages.audio_transcription.lyrics_unma: Some lyrics did not match a sounding note and need review.
messages.audio_transcription.missing_whi: Local lyric recognition requires whisper-cli and a multilingual model. Run setup-audio.ps1 or configure their paths.
messages.audio_transcription.monophonic_: This is a dominant monophonic pitch candidate. Accompaniment, harmony and octaves may confuse it; compare with the original.
messages.audio_transcription.no_lyrics: No usable lyric text was recognized; melody analysis remains available.
messages.audio_transcription.no_notes: No usable melody notes were found in this selection.
messages.audio_transcription.progress_qu: Quantizing rhythm and mapping source time
messages.audio_transcription.tempo_meter: Tempo and 4/4 meter are suggestions; correct them before generating accompaniment.
messages.audio_transcription.temporary_f: Could not write temporary audio for lyric recognition.
messages.audio_transcription.unsupported: The decoded audio format is unsupported.
messages.audio_transcription.vocal_filte: Vocal-band filtering was used; it is not isolated vocal extraction.
messages.audio_transcription.whisper_tim: Local lyric recognition exceeded its ten-minute deadline.
cli.transcribe_audio: Analyze an MP3/WAV selection into a reviewable numbered-score project.
cli.audio_end: Selection end in original-audio seconds (up to 120s per selection).
cli.audio_bpm: Suggested quarter-note BPM, or 0 for automatic.
cli.audio_tonic: Tonic pitch class 0..11, or -1 for automatic.
cli.lyrics_file: Corrected TXT or timestamped LRC lyric file.
cli.recognize_lyrics: Recognize lyric drafts locally with whisper.cpp.
cli.notation_image: Save the actual generated numbered-score PNG.
cli.audio_task_check: Check original playback and background audio review with a fixture.
cli.whole_song_candidates: List three complete deterministic accompaniment candidates.
cli.accompaniment_variant: Generate stable, flowing or sparse whole-song accompaniment.
messages.whole_song.variant: accompaniment-variant must be stable, flowing or sparse.
messages.audio_transcription.whisper_tok: The recognizer emitted UTF-8 token fragments; complete text was retained with provisional segment timestamps.
cli.audio_whole_song: Analyze the entire source (up to20 minutes) using bounded chunks.
messages.audio_transcription.silent_chun: A silent chunk was retained as rests; no lyrics were generated for it.
messages.audio_transcription.whole_song_: Whole-song analysis used bounded chunks; inspect joins, tempo and lyric alignment.
cli.audio_language: Lyric recognition language: auto, zh or en.
